direction: Continue with cvrp_parallel_merge_static under postprocess none, preserving the round-2 best as baseline while probing focused variations of the L2a static merge scoring: route-pair candidate ordering, distance/savings normalization, and deterministic tie-breaking.

operations.mechanism: Only one template and one postprocess mode are allowed, so the best use of the remaining budget is local meta-tuning of the active solver rather than broad exploration. Deterministic tie-breaking should reduce variance within the 500 ms per-instance budget and make scalar-score comparisons attributable to merge-ranking changes.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: The round-2 improvement of -0.5667 to best objective 17.3982 indicates that static merge ordering is on a productive trajectory; controlled local changes to merge-pair ranking should yield additional CVRP objective reduction without changing template or postprocessing.
